summary: Cul-de-sac bulb edge backing onto bush beside a motorway, homes about 20 m west.
reasons: Homes about 15-20 m across the bulb
Van already parked in the bulb

drivers.seclusion: East side is bush then the motorway. Unmapped houses stand roughly 15-20 m west around the turning circle; OSM lists no buildings but the imagery shows several.
drivers.access_and_room: Sealed dead-end turning circle, easy for a 2WD van; a white van is parked in the bulb in the Esri image, so room exists. North of about 12 m the line runs through bush with no road.
drivers.traffic: Dead-end with little through traffic; constant motorway noise from the east.
drivers.convention: A parked van in the bulb suggests parking there is tolerated; no signs or markings seen.

flags: Steep: about 4.5% at best section, 9% mean over the whole line
Houses within 25 m not in OSM
sun_shade: Open at the bulb with bush shade creeping in from the east in the morning.
rubbish: Some scattered debris in the bush strip north of the bulb
cannot_judge: Whether the bulb is used by residents for overflow parking

best_section.where: East edge of the Carinya Street turning circle, before the bush strip begins
